Fayette, Alabama · Family-Owned Since 1985

Scratch biscuits, fried chicken, and a table that feels like home.

Charles' Cafeteria & Grill has been Fayette's breakfast-and-lunch buffet for four decades — scratch-made biscuits, fried pork chops, fried green tomatoes, and homemade strawberry jam, served cash-and-carry from 6 AM to 2 PM, Monday through Friday.
